contract.reader: An engineer or student who can set up a discretization (entries 1 and 2) and now faces a 2D or 3D system too large for a dense library call
contract.problem: Whether to use a direct or an iterative solver, and why the answer depends on dimension, size and conditioning
contract.outcome: Estimate memory and flops of dense, banded and sparse direct solvers; explain fill-in and the h^-2 growth of the condition number; predict iteration counts for Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, SOR and CG; choose a solver family
contract.contribution: Every cost and rate tied to the series' model problem and checked by computation (fill-in, condition number, rounding floor, measured iteration counts against predictions), ending in a cost table and a decision diagram
contract.evidence: Derivations and operation counts; five scripts with real output; Briggs-Henson-McCormick, Davis, George 1973, Golub-Van Loan, Hestenes-Stiefel 1952, Higham, Saad, Trefethen-Bau
contract.limitations: SPD model problem only; multigrid and preconditioners described, not implemented; nonsymmetric Krylov methods out of scope

findings.location: Section 5.1 CG iteration display (desktop-light-13, mobile-light-24); at 360 px also Section 1.1 definition of A and T (mobile-light-03, 04)
findings.problem: The four CG formulas are on one line wider than the column: at 1280 px the display stops at 'r^(m+1) = r^(m) - alpha_m' and the search-direction update p^(m+1) is entirely hidden, with no cue; at 360 px only alpha_m is visible. At 360 px the matrix T of Section 1.1 is not visible ('T =' only)
findings.whyItMatters: The text announces three vector updates and the reader sees one and a half; the direction update is what distinguishes CG from steepest descent; T is the building block of every matrix on the page
findings.action: Set the CG iteration as an aligned block, one formula per line; at 360 px put the definition of T on its own line below A
findings.acceptance: All four CG formulas fully visible without sideways scrolling at 1280 and 360 px, and T visible at 360 px
